import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN on "school_name"
joined_df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="school_name", how="inner", suffixes=('_0', '_1'))

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source3_41_0.school_name with aggregations:
# sum(Source3_41_0.size) -> Total Students (int)
# sum(Source3_41_0.budget) -> Total School Budget (int)
# avg(Source3_41_1.math_score) -> Average Math Score (float)
# avg(Source3_41_1.reading_score) -> Average Reading Score (float)

agg_df = joined_df.groupby("school_name").agg(
    Total_Students=pd.NamedAgg(column="size", aggfunc="sum"),
    Total_School_Budget=pd.NamedAgg(column="budget", aggfunc="sum"),
    Average_Math_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="math_score", aggfunc="mean"),
    Average_Reading_Score=pd.NamedAgg(column="reading_score", aggfunc="mean"),
).reset_index()

# According to target schema, rename columns to match exactly:
# 'Total Students', 'Total School Budget', 'Average Math Score', 'Average Reading Score'
agg_df.rename(columns={
    "Total_Students": "Total Students",
    "Total_School_Budget": "Total School Budget",
    "Average_Math_Score": "Average Math Score",
    "Average_Reading_Score": "Average Reading Score"
}, inplace=True)

# The target schema does not include school_name, so drop it
agg_df = agg_df.drop(columns=["school_name"])

# Ensure data types match target schema
agg_df["Total Students"] = agg_df["Total Students"].astype(int)
agg_df["Total School Budget"] = agg_df["Total School Budget"].astype(int)
agg_df["Average Math Score"] = agg_df["Average Math Score"].astype(float)
agg_df["Average Reading Score"] = agg_df["Average Reading Score"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on school_name (common column)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, how='inner', left_on='school_name', right_on='school_name')

# Group by 'School ID' (leftmost integer unique column in target)
# Aggregations:
# - Total Students: count of students (count Student ID)
# - Total School Budget: sum of budget (from source0)
# - Average Math Score: average of math_score (from source1)
# - Average Reading Score: average of reading_score (from source1)

# Count total students per School ID
total_students = joined.groupby('School ID')['Student ID'].count()

# Sum budget per School ID (budget is same per school, so sum or max is same)
total_budget = joined.groupby('School ID')['budget'].first()

# Average math and reading scores per School ID
avg_math = joined.groupby('School ID')['math_score'].mean()
avg_reading = joined.groupby('School ID')['reading_score'].mean()

# Combine all into final dataframe
result = pd.DataFrame({
    'Total Students': total_students,
    'Total School Budget': total_budget,
    'Average Math Score': avg_math,
    'Average Reading Score': avg_reading
}).reset_index(drop=True)

# Write to output CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_41/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
